messages:
Julia K: Quick sync — thinking about tightening postmortem follow-ups. Proposal: a lightweight 'action-tracker' board + weekly triage cadence for recurring incident patterns. Thoughts?

Samir: +1. Can we add owner, due date, and a verification SLA for follow-ups? Also a simple 'recurrence score' tag (1-5) would help prioritize.

Aisha: Love it. Suggest we standardize the timeline: Detection -> Triage -> Mitigation -> RCA -> Follow-ups (owners + verification). A 5-line checklist could be in the postmortem template.

Ben (IC-bot): deploy-bot posted a Sev2 last night (incident 1801223344) — can use that as a seed for the board's recurrence column.

Ravi: Comms cadence idea: initial ack within 5m, status updates every 15m for Sev1 until mitigation, end-of-incident summary on Slack, postmortem draft within 72h (internal). For external comms, coordinate with comms team before public post.

Maya: On IC rotation — propose a 6-week rotation window with 2 nominated backups. Auto-generated calendar invites and a short-runbook for first 24h responsibilities. We should store rotation metadata in a repo so infra can automate reminders.

Julia K: Agreed on structure. I'll sketch a timeline template. Who wants to own the first pass of the board and the rotation automation? Prefer owners by EOD Friday so we can test next week's cadence.

Samir: I can spin up a Notion board and add columns: Backlog, Active follow-ups, Awaiting verification, Done. I'll include fields: owner, due date, recurrence_score, verification_link. Will try to have it ready by Friday.

Aisha: I'll draft the timeline + comms checklist (short, copyable) and add it to the postmortem template. Will include required verification artifacts (dashboards/log snippets). Targeting Thursday.

Ravi: For verification evidence, require a link and one-line proof. Example field: `verification: https://grafana/... — error rate back to baseline`. Prefer automation to push a verification check to the board when metrics show recovery.

Maya: I'll schedule a 30-min monthly 'incident patterns' review (invite infra, platform, product leads) to triage recurrence items and suggest systemic fixes. Will create the recurring calendar entry this afternoon.

Julia K: Nice. Quick inline timeline prototype:

```
Timeline template:
- 00:00 Detect (who/what alerted)
- 00:05 Acknowledge + assign IC
- 00:15 Initial triage & mitigation plan
- 01:00 Stabilized or escalation notes
- 24h RCA draft (if Sev1/2)
- 72h Postmortem draft and follow-ups populated
Follow-ups item fields:
- Owner: <name>
- Due: YYYY-MM-DD
- Verification: link to dashboard/logs
- Recurrence_score: 1-5
```

Julia K: Action summary: Samir -> create board (due Fri), Aisha -> timeline & comms template (due Thu), Maya -> schedule monthly review (due Mon). I'll update the incident runbook with the 6-week IC rotation proposal and tentative backups. Please ping here when tasks are done. :thumbsup: 

Samir: Confirmed — I'll post the Notion link here when ready and add two sample follow-ups from the recent incidents.

Aisha: Posted a draft timeline in the doc; added a comms checklist snippet. Open to edits.

Maya: Calendar invite created (Monthly incident patterns review). Invite includes an agenda and a short prep checklist.

Ben (IC-bot): Noted. Will start tagging postmortems with recurrence_score when created to help populate the new board.

Julia K: Great work team — let's try this lightweight flow for two months and revisit. If anyone wants to pair on automation (rotation reminders / verification hooks), LMK and we'll slot time. Thanks!
